user.title: CatGenie (Petnovations)
user.description: Enter the signing key extracted from the CatGenie app (the 32-character key or the 84-character secret) and a refresh token captured from the app. See the integration README for how to obtain these.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate CatGenie
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials stopped working. Paste a fresh refresh token (and the signing key if it changed).

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the signing key and refresh token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the CatGenie cloud.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
